patterns.note: Full-width sections with varied background colors (white, light gray, light purple, dark purple) are used to visually segment content, each containing a centered, max-width content area.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and sans-serif, often multi-line, creating a strong visual hierarchy. Section introductions frequently use smaller, uppercase labels.

A primary brand palette of deep and lighter purples (#604dad) is consistently used for navigation, section backgrounds, and key elements, contrasted with a vibrant coral/orange (#e76f51) for primary call-to-action buttons.
The site features a transforming sticky header: initially two distinct navigation bars, they combine into a single, more compact bar with a solid background as the user scrolls past the hero section.
Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used within content sections, pairing descriptive text with illustrative graphics or device mockups, often alternating sides down the page.

technique_notes: The site features a dynamic sticky header that transforms upon scroll. Initially, two distinct navigation bars are present; as the user scrolls past the hero section, these collapse into a single, more compact navigation bar with a solid background, maintaining key navigation elements and a primary call-to-action.
Content sections are visually separated by alternating full-width background colors, with all content contained within a consistent maximum width and centered on the page.
Call-to-action buttons are designed with a vibrant, contrasting color and subtle rounded corners, ensuring high visibility and a clear interactive affordance.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often uppercase labels for section introductions; body text is a comfortable reading size.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (e.g., buttons, cards, images), consistent across interactive elements and content containers.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy; the hero section is notably airy, while feature grids maintain a comfortable, balanced density.

standout: The distinctive use of a deep, rich purple as a primary brand color, combined with a vibrant coral for CTAs, creates a sophisticated yet approachable feel. The transforming sticky header, which consolidates two navigation bars into one, is a notable functional and aesthetic detail that enhances user experience on scroll.
